CompanyBrandingLogo.title: CompanyBrandingLogo
CompanyBrandingLogo.description: Stores the persistent corporate logo image (Data URI or HTTPS URL) shared across all browsers, sessions, and server restarts.

logoUrl.description: Base64 Data URI, SVG Data URI, or HTTPS URL of the corporate logo (blob: URLs disallowed)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last logo update

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified administrator who saved the logo

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Authorized system administrator document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin role was granted

UserAccountTheme.title: UserAccountTheme
UserAccountTheme.description: Stores a verified user's personal UI theme preference (eye-friendly light or dark palette) scoped per PDKS account key.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last theme update

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in owner

/admins/{uid}.description: Verified administrator registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID

/user_preferences/{uid}/account_themes/{.description: Per-account UI theme preferences strictly owned by the authenticated Firebase user UID
